item.text: {"summary":"The forecast is publication-ready in resolver, target coherence, traceability, and ladder structure, with minor gaps in explicit model-prior framing and evidence for the stated update.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"warning","summary":"The persistence prior is stated, but no explicit time-series/model prior or ruled-out alternative is identified.","actionRequested":"Name the persistence or other time-series prior explicitly as the model prior and briefly state why no richer model is used."},{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The draft mentions moderating nominal wages and CPI-U volatility without citing current observations, while the point remains at the prior median.","actionRequested":"Either state explicitly that current evidence does not warrant movement from the prior, or cite dated nominal-wage/CPI evidence and quantify its adjustment."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Clarify that the -0.7 to 0.5 bounds are the interpolated 10th and 90th percentiles from the threshold ladder, rather than implying they are directly realized-volatility bounds."]}
